fishing: WHEN: Thu Nov 19 fair solunar, winds 5-13 N, mild 67-84F, water 74-75F. PASSES-BEACH: Spanish mackerel, whiting, ladyfish, flounder, jacks, blue runners at Englewood Beach / Manasota / Blind Pass / Stump Pass; live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: baby gags and trout on grassy flats, Spanish/ladyfish/bluefish along ICW and Stump Pass; redfish under mangroves/oysters, snook, sheepshead on docks. NEARSHORE: cobia, snapper, sheepshead, Spanish when seas allow; deeper grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless spoons, popping cork. Sources: Fishin Franks / FL Sportsman SW recent (redfish solid on live baits/oysters/mangroves, snook/trout active).
redtide: FWC Nov 13 update: K. brevis at background concentrations in SWFL (one Sarasota sample, offshore Pinellas and Collier). No bloom concentrations near Englewood/Manasota. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation reported. Next update Nov 20.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota ~149 minor isolated outages; no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
